cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Impossible Currency
cards.instruction: Price every favor in symbolic acts, imaginary resources, or promises that cannot be measured normally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I'll fix the kettle for a spoonful of yesterday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do I give you yesterday?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Start with the five minutes you wasted this morning.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then leave it overnight. I can wait for the currency to mature.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 how to give yesterday causes A3 time tender; B4 today correction causes A5 waiting overnight. The A3 mismatch is a repairable proposed tender, not hidden chronology.

relationship.evidence: B2 asks how payment works and B4 notices a real date mismatch, supplying meaningful practical participation.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns B4 correction into maturing currency, developing the price system rather than abandoning the favor.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 generic dominance preface distracts from the useful five-minute tender; A5 maturity is earned by B4 date.
